bufflist.desc.minecraft.instant_health: Instantly heals %s HP (%s hearts); damages undead instead.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.instant_damage: Instantly deals %s damage; heals undead instead.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.jump_boost: Jump higher; fall damage reduced by %s.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.regeneration: Heals 1 HP (half a heart) every %s s.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.fire_resistance: Immune to fire, lava and magma blocks.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.invisibility: Body is invisible (armor and held items still show); mobs notice you less.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.blindness: Vision greatly reduced; cannot sprint or crit.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.night_vision: See clearly in the dark; flickers in the last 10 s.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.hunger: Hunger drains faster: about 1 extra food point every %s s.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.poison: 1 damage every %s s; cannot kill (stops at half a heart).
bufflist.desc.minecraft.wither: 1 damage every %s s; can kill. Health bar turns black.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.absorption: Gain %s extra HP (%s golden hearts) that absorb damage first.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.saturation: Restores %s food and %s saturation every tick.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.levitation: Float upward at about %s blocks per second.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.luck: Better loot from fishing and loot chests.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.unluck: Worse loot from fishing and loot chests.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.conduit_power: Underwater: breathe, see clearly, mining speed +%s%%.
bufflist.desc.minecraft.bad_omen: Entering a village starts a raid (raid level %s).
bufflist.desc.minecraft.hero_of_the_vill: Villager trades about %s%% cheaper (at least 1 item); villagers give gifts.
bufflist.settings.title: Better Buff Display Settings
